verdict.rationale: The evidence describes an on-device inference SDK with a programmatic chat API (`[ChatMessage]`), a terminal CLI (Wally/rcli) that runs local models, and integrations that point third-party tools like opencode at a model. None of these is a built-in graphical chat interface. The SDK chat API is a developer building block and the CLI is terminal-based, so neither earns credit for a first-party GUI chat app.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can chat with local models using a built-in graphical chat interface
